## Problem / 问题

Describe the trigger and impact. / 描述触发条件与影响。

## Change / 改动

Explain the resulting behavior; attach screenshots for UI changes. / 说明修改后的行为，界面变更附截图。

## Validation / 验证

List the OS and checks actually run, plus any remaining limitations. / 列出实际执行的系统、检查及剩余限制。

- [ ] Relevant tests pass / 相关测试已通过
- [ ] Chinese and English text updated where applicable / 已同步受影响的双语文本
- [ ] User-visible changes recorded in the changelog / 已记录用户可感知的变化
- [ ] No keys, private task data, annotations or unlicensed paper files / 不含密钥、私有任务、批注或未获许可的论文文件
